steps.title: Rank hypotheses
steps.detail: checkout-service v7.19.0 address validation blocks checkout

output.summary: Conversion fell about 40% on 2024-06-10 and stayed low on 2024-06-11, then recovered by 2024-06-12. The drop hit every region and platform evenly, and the checkout start rate did not move, so customers were lost after they started checkout. The checkout-service v7.19.0 release shipped on 2024-06-10 with stricter address validation, which a bug report ties to rejected addresses at checkout.

causes.title: checkout-service v7.19.0 address validation blocks checkout

claims.text: Conversion rate fell 40.1% on 2024-06-10 against the same weekday baseline, and the drop was about equal across all regions and platforms.
Checkout-service v7.19.0 was released on 2024-06-10 and enabled a new address normalizer for all orders.
A regression issue reports that the stricter validation in v7.19.0 rejects valid addresses with unit numbers, so customers cannot continue to payment on any region or platform.
The checkout start rate stayed near 0.122 on 2024-06-10 while conversion dropped to 0.0496, so the loss happened after customers started checkout.
